newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Beach gets further payout from IRL.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Beach gets further payout from IRL.

text.p: Beach Petroleum NL said on Tuesday that it had received a further A$500,000 payout from the liquidators of the failed Independent Resources Group.
This was in settlement of debts owing to Beach by Cortaus Ltd and brought the total monies recovered so far to A$13 million, the oil and gas explorer said.
In addition, Beach said it had received a charge over a 40 percent interest the Linden gold joint venture in Western Australia from the liquidator of Consolidated Gold Mines of Australia.
In the late 1980s, Beach was part of the Independent Resources (IRL) group which was the subject of extensive investigation and prosecution in the wake of in-house deals.

Group members including Spargos, Jingellic Minerals, Enterprise Gold Mines, Cortaus Ltd, Consolidated Gold Mines of Australia and Claremont Petroleum were involved in legal actions, some of which are still going on.

Beach added that having now completely repaid its outstanding loan from Westpac Banking Corp, it was now debt free and had arranged a new A$3 million credit facility on normal commercial terms to be drawn on when the company deemeds it appropriate.
By 2.30 p.m. (0430 GMT), Beach shares were steady at 8.3 cents on turnover of 35,000 shares.
